content.page_summary: Reference list (items 841-848) covering pharmacodynamic interactions of antiplatelet agents and proton-pump inhibitors, and multiple studies and meta-analyses on influenza vaccination and other therapies (colchicine) in relation to cardiovascular disease and outcomes.
